scenario: A Chinese-speaking independent recruiter managing several searches intentionally imports one chat screenshot on a phone, reviews supported changes, and may leave and resume. Success is a truthful saved/confirmed receipt with no unsupported state or implied external action.
frozen_evidence: Current working-copy docs/product.md, docs/capture-to-action.md, docs/design-system.md, REVIEW.md; no implementation claims inferred
No accepted screenshots; two in-app browser operations timed out

review_plan.reason: Core recruiter capture, review, and return workflow.
Identity, claims, retention, and confirmation boundaries.
Mobile comparison and evidence review; concept-level only.
No candidate assessment or model-grader quality decision. Workflow measurements are reviewed without psychometric or evaluator-validity claims.
No candidate-facing communication or release review; sensitive-source control is covered by evidence safety.
No current-market comparison required; the Granola analogy is not used as supporting evidence.

findings.observation: The concept gives two incompatible descriptions of its two decisions: owner then attachment, versus identity/context then changes. The latter also hides multiple independently correctable judgments in its first lane.
findings.evidence: Frozen source S1, S2 and S4; Notion sections 前端设计重点, 前端还可以更深一层, 深化补充｜三种设计方向.
findings.user_impact: Implementation can repeat person selection, require premature Pursuit entry, or omit the separate fact-confirmation decision.
findings.recommendation: Treat two lanes as presentation groups. Show evidence first; resolve only blocking identity/speaker/context questions; separately confirm a visible proposed change set. Allow unresolved capture before person or Pursuit is known.
findings.verification: Walk a known-person import, an unknown-person import, and a person with two Pursuits; no repeated identity entry, no forced invented context, and binding never confirms facts.

findings.observation: The concept groups no_action and identity_review as insufficient-clue outcomes and optimizes step count without specifying distinct queue resolution or error-detection measures.
findings.evidence: Frozen source S3 and S7; 背后的 agent contract and Frontend eval.
findings.user_impact: A pending identity decision may look finished, while an intentionally complete no-action import may remain unnecessary work.
findings.recommendation: Keep needs identity/context review, needs fact review, processing failed, and complete with no change distinct. Surface one reason and one next step; measure time and seeded-error detection alongside taps.
findings.verification: Recruiters distinguish a pending identity item from a completed no-change receipt and resume either without reconstructing its history; report unassisted correctness and timing against a manual note baseline.

strengths: Intentional capture starts from a concrete recruiter job.
Unresolved is a normal recoverable outcome.
Exact evidence and separate action review are explicitly valued.
missing_evidence: No executable flow, observed tap counts, realistic interruption trial, or recruiter study; no numerical workflow score is justified.
open_questions: Which of the two lane definitions is authoritative?

reviews.lens: evidence integrity, privacy, and safe action

findings.observation: The concept permits supported facts to commit while relative dates remain unresolved, but does not define which claims depend on unresolved identity, speaker, context, or event time. SourceEnvelope names capture time without explicitly separating message and effective time.
findings.evidence: Frozen source S5 and S6; 子模块合同 and 当前运行证据 / Story eval.
findings.user_impact: An explicit sentence can still describe the wrong speaker or relationship. A historical screenshot imported today can create stale current state or a wrongly anchored deadline.
findings.recommendation: Require claim-level support and resolved dependencies before confirmation. Distinguish captured-at, message time, effective interval, and clue-owner validity. Unknown identity/speaker/context blocks dependent claims; unknown date blocks only time-dependent claims and actions. Never anchor relative dates to import time by default.
findings.verification: Synthetic group chat, historical screenshot, recycled identifier, and mixed clear/relative-date cases produce zero unsupported confirmed claims. Confirm an independent fact only when its subject, speaker, context, and relevant temporal validity are resolved.

findings.observation: The concept supports raw images used only for a run while separately requiring a return to the same source crop and revision; persistence conditions and expiry behavior are unspecified.
findings.evidence: Frozen source S3, S5 and S6; 背后的 agent contract, SourceEnvelope, and final Story eval.
findings.user_impact: The implementation may retain an undisclosed source or promise a recoverable original that has already been deleted. Reopening an old revision can also apply a decision after identity or source authorization has changed.
findings.recommendation: Define resumable encrypted-source retention and text-only/transient modes explicitly, including expiry and derived crop deletion. Resume the reviewed revision, then revalidate current authorization, identity ownership, and target-state version before enabling commit; show conflicts rather than overwriting.
findings.verification: Close and resume under both retention modes, then repeat after source expiry, deletion, owner change, and another reviewer update. No false original-source recovery, no stale commit, and no undeclared retained crop.

strengths: ChangeSet links previous/proposed values, evidence, and consequences.
The page separates fact confirmation from action review.
missing_evidence: No data-flow inventory, retention implementation, deletion propagation proof, claim dependency implementation, or stale-state execution evidence.
open_questions: What exactly survives a run in each retention mode?
Which dependencies make an otherwise explicit fact ineligible for partial confirmation?

reviews.lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery

findings.observation: Side-by-side temporal comparison is prescribed without a narrow-screen or large-text variant.
findings.evidence: Frozen source S1; 前端设计重点 item 3. Canonical docs/design-system.md, Inline identity comparison and Surface adaptation.
findings.user_impact: If implemented literally, two columns may hide the distinguishing clue, its effective dates, or the consequence of choosing a historical owner.
findings.recommendation: Preserve a single contextual comparison, using stacked current/historical sections on mobile and columns only when space supports them. Do not preselect a person; use text for ownership state and place the commit control after the consequence.
findings.verification: In a responsive prototype, both temporal roles, differentiating clues, consequences, unresolved outcome, and primary action remain reachable without horizontal scrolling at narrow widths and accessibility text sizes.

findings.observation: Crop-based review is specified; accessible text is named, but the required speaker and time context around a crop is not defined.
findings.evidence: Frozen source S2 and S5; source-local crop proposal and EvidenceLens contract.
findings.user_impact: A highly legible cropped sentence can remove the speaker or date evidence needed to judge its meaning. Text-only or screen-reader review may not expose the same correction context.
findings.recommendation: Pair each crop with editable extracted text, speaker state, and message-time context; retain an authorized route to surrounding messages or clearly state source unavailability.
findings.verification: A forwarded-message and ambiguous-speaker prototype case presents equivalent decision evidence visually and through assistive technology, with correction before confirmation.

strengths: Unresolved is explicitly framed as a calm returnable state.
The EvidenceLens contract includes an accessible text alternative.
missing_evidence: Evidence level 5: written concept only; no accepted screenshot or interactive prototype.
In-app browser creation and selection timed out. Typography, target size, focus, VoiceOver, animation, latency, and real recovery were not verified.
open_questions: How does the comparison adapt at accessibility text sizes?

top_findings.reason: The two lane definitions disagree and can obscure fact confirmation.
top_findings.next_step: Define identity/context resolution separately from claim confirmation; do not force complete scope on entry.
top_findings.verification: Known, unknown, and multi-Pursuit cases complete without repeated entry or implied fact confirmation.

top_findings.reason: Explicit source wording alone does not establish subject, speaker, scope, or temporal validity.
top_findings.next_step: Specify per-claim dependencies and distinguish import, message, effective, and ownership time.
top_findings.verification: Ambiguity blocks all dependent claims and actions while independent fully supported claims remain confirmable.

top_findings.reason: Transient originals and same-crop resumption need compatible retention rules and stale-state checks.
top_findings.next_step: Define retained-source versus text-only modes and revalidate before resuming a commit.
top_findings.verification: Expiry, deletion, ownership change, and concurrent revision cases neither leak source assets nor accept stale changes.

adjudication.rationale: The written direction supports the product loop but is not implementation-ready until decision, claim-dependency, and retention/recovery contracts are clarified. A single agent applied three lenses sequentially; this is not independent reviewer consensus. Individual packets abstain from release scoring because no executable or visual evidence is available. No runtime defect or active safety veto was established; missing proof is not proof of failure.

next_tests.test: Review a compact flow for known, unknown, and multi-Pursuit identities with representative recruiters.
next_tests.evidence_required: Observed decisions, receipt comprehension, seeded-error detection, time, and manual baseline.
next_tests.pass_condition: Participants distinguish source saving, identity attachment, fact confirmation, and external authorization; no forced invented scope.

next_tests.test: Exercise partial confirmation using group messages, historical screenshots, relative dates, and changed clue ownership.
next_tests.evidence_required: Synthetic fixtures and readback of confirmed claims and blocked dependencies.
next_tests.pass_condition: Zero unsupported dependent claims enter current relationship state; independent claims can still be confirmed.

next_tests.test: Resume each retention mode after interruption, expiry, deletion, source revocation, and concurrent changes.
next_tests.evidence_required: Source availability, review revision, destination version, and state readback.
next_tests.pass_condition: Receipt is truthful, deleted originals/crops are unavailable, and stale writes require renewed review.

next_tests.test: Verify temporal comparison and source context in a narrow and accessibility-size prototype.
next_tests.pass_condition: Both ownership roles, speaker/time context, corrections, and consequences remain accessible without horizontal scrolling.
